verdicts_or_reports.expected: Applying a category chip should also update the main-screen toolbar to reflect the selected category.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The category chip becomes selected when switching between Food and Transport, but the top toolbar remains the unchanged daily amount and does not reflect the selected category.
steps: On the main screen, enter 1 using the number pad.
Tap the Transport category chip; it becomes selected.
Observe the top toolbar still displays $0.9 and does not reflect Transport.
Switch to Food and then back to Transport; the toolbar remains unchanged.
